plugin.browser.start.description: A browser surface mounted; url is the address it opens (empty when none) and source is restored for the address of the tab state, home for the home setting, or history for a region that restored the session history of an unloaded tab, which loads nothing.

plugin.browser.command.description: A command of the surface ran; error is <code>: <text> when ok is false, and the level is warn for a failure.

plugin.browser.address.commit.description: The person pressed Enter in the address bar; value is the text of the bar and url the address that was sent to the document region.

plugin.browser.history.move.description: A move to another entry of the session history, by index.

plugin.browser.navigation.description: The address of the document changed.

plugin.browser.load.description: The document finished loading; micros is the time since the state reported loading.

plugin.browser.region.failure.description: The document region reported an error in its state; reason is the text of the error.

plugin.browser.report.description: The page of the view failed: an error or a rejection of the page, a refused call of the view channel, or a loss of the view calls; text states the error.
